name: Sapphire of Sky
summary: The Sapphire of Sky is one of four sacred Relics of Wakening kept by the night elves within Ban'ethil Barrow Den. It is an essential focus used to safely summon sleeping Druids of the Talon back from the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: The Wakening Ritual
sections.body: Deep within the roots of Teldrassil, Druids of the Talon commune with the wilds while resting in hibernation within Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Awakening from such deep trance-states into the waking world is a fragile, perilous process. To safeguard the transition, the druids rely on four consecrated artifacts known as the Relics of Wakening: the Black Feather Quill, the Raven Claw Talisman, the Rune of Nesting, and the Sapphire of Sky. Without this resonant gem, the harmony required to call sleeping spirits back from the Emerald Dream remains incomplete, leaving them vulnerable to eternal entrapment.

sections.title: The Threat in Ban'ethil
sections.body: When corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs overran the barrow den, the sacred artifacts were left behind in their ornate repositories. The Sapphire of Sky resides secured inside the Chest of the Sky amidst the winding subterranean corridors. With the druids still slumbering as the furbolgs rampage around them, retrieving this jewel alongside its companion relics is an urgent matter for Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar before the sleepers are permanently lost.

faq.q: What is the Sapphire of Sky?
faq.answer: It is a sacred gemstone and one of the four Relics of Wakening stored within Ban'ethil Barrow Den. It works in conjunction with three avian talismans to safely guide Druids of the Talon out of the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Where is the Sapphire of Sky kept?
aliases: where to find sapphire of sky
faq.answer: It is preserved inside the Chest of the Sky, resting within the underground labyrinth of Ban'ethil Barrow Den in central Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is the sapphire needed right now?
faq.answer: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs invaded Ban'ethil Barrow Den, putting the slumbering druids in grave danger. Druids deep in trance cannot simply wake up on their own; Athridas Bearmantle requires the sapphire and other relics to perform the delicate ritual of wakening before the sleepers are lost forever.
The Druids of the Talon and ritual keepers such as Athridas Bearmantle use it during the communal rites that wake slumbering brothers from their deep communion with nature.

angles.text: The sapphire exemplifies the careful rituals required when projecting one's spirit into the Emerald Dream, demonstrating how easily a communion can turn fatal without sacred anchors.
Preserving the sacred artifacts in Ban'ethil Barrow Den is critical to safeguarding the fragile order of Teldrassil amidst mounting corruption.
